serverInfo.name: whatsunity-compound-os
serverInfo.description: Model Context Protocol Server for WhatsUnity Compound OS — Tools for cryptographic offline QR gate pass verification, maintenance ticket lifecycle inspection across 9 operational trades, and community operations telemetry.

tools.name: verify_gate_pass
tools.description: Cryptographically verify a residential or visitor QR gate pass in sub-50ms offline mode or online sync mode.

passCode.description: Cryptographically signed visitor or resident QR pass payload.

tools.name: query_community_status
tools.description: Retrieve live community operational metrics, gate connectivity status, and maintenance volume.

compoundId.description: Unique identifier of the residential compound (defaults to public showcase).

tools.name: list_maintenance_trades
tools.description: List the 9 maintenance trade specializations (Plumbing, Electrical, HVAC, Carpentry, Painting, Masonry, Elevators, Landscaping, Pest Control) and on-duty technician rosters.

tools.name: search_compound_directory
tools.description: Search verified resident public directory and emergency contacts within the compound.
